{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Remove rows where biomarker_baseline is -999 (QC failure)
valid_data = data[data['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Step 2: Deduplicate by keeping highest sample_seq per patient_id
# Sort by sample_seq descending, then drop duplicates on patient_id
valid_data = valid_data.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Step 3: Compute mean baseline biomarker value
mean_baseline = valid_data['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

# Print result
print(mean_baseline)"}
